visualCharacteristics: Tabbed content switcher. A horizontal row of tab buttons above a bordered panel; clicking a tab reveals its panel. Panels hold rich content (paragraphs, images, lists).
contentPattern: Repeating rows; each row = 2 cells: cell 1 = tab label, cell 2 = tab panel content.
usage: Tabbed sections such as Overview / Itinerary / What to Bring on adventure detail pages.
